title: Academy Certificate Download Returns 403 Forbidden Error

extracted_facts.problem: The customer's Academy course-completion certificate download link returned a 403 Forbidden error when clicked.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The certificate link had been generated while the customer was logged into a different Contentstack org than the one their Academy enrollment was under, so the download request didn't match the enrollment's access scope.
resolution_steps: Log out of the current Contentstack org.
Log back in under the org where the Academy enrollment is registered.
Regenerate the certificate link from the Academy dashboard.
